description: Adds a sheet to a drawing (IDrawingDoc.NewSheet4): a standard size (a4 … a0, a … e, landscape or portrait) or a custom width_mm and height_mm (sheet mm), a scale, a projection, and a sheet format (.SLDDRT), each the drawing's first sheet's when absent. The new sheet is shown. Checked: there is one more sheet, and its size reads back within 0.01 mm, its scale exactly, its projection and format as asked. Otherwise it is deleted again (rolled back).

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

name.description: The new sheet's name; one no sheet has. SOLIDWORKS' next free SheetN when absent.

size.description: A standard paper size: a4, a3, a2, a1, a0 (ISO) or a, b, c, d, e (ANSI). Not with width_mm and height_mm.

orientation.description: With size: landscape (the default) or portrait.

width_mm.description: A custom sheet's width, sheet mm, with height_mm; 10 to 10000.

height_mm.description: A custom sheet's height, sheet mm, with width_mm; 10 to 10000.

numerator.description: The first number of the ratio, more than 0.

denominator.description: The second number of the ratio, more than 0.

scale.description: The sheet's scale: views that follow the sheet are drawn at it.

format.description: Full path of a sheet format (.SLDDRT).
